rows.grounds: compound sarva-jīva-svarūpā; describes the goddess as having the nature of all beings
compound ādi-ātma-liṅga-svarūpiṇī; describes the goddess as having the form of the primordial self-liṅga

items.question: What additional essential form characterizes the supreme goddess alongside being the nature of all beings?
premises: The supreme goddess is of the nature of all beings.
The goddess is also characterized by another essential form.
This additional form is that of the primordial self-liṅga.
items.inference: Therefore, the supreme goddess embodies both the nature of all beings and the form of the primordial self-liṅga.
uncertainties: The internal analysis of ādātmaliṅga as ādi-ātma-liṅga follows the legacy hint but the exact compound resolution is interpretive.
items.plain_english: She is of the nature of all beings and has the form of the primordial self-liṅga.
